baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins مُتَّقِينَ from و ق ي to مَفَازًا from ف و ز.
baseline_models.mechanism: Placing the self within protection is paired with an outcome that combines escape from harm, acquisition of good, and possession of what is sought.

activation_trace.role: Self-placement inside protection supplies the recipients' active protective posture.
Rescue from evil together with winning good supplies the compound outcome.

changed_reading.after: Those who actively place themselves within protection have an outcome that is both rescue from harm and attainment of good.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَفَازًا carries the ف و ز branch in which a mafāzah oscillates between rescue and a waterless, deadly waste.
baseline_models.mechanism: The result need not be a static prize: the dangerous place and the place of deliverance can be the same terrain, while و ق ي marks its recipients as safeguarded traversers.

activation_trace.role: A barrier that repels injury supplies protection during exposure to danger.
The rescue-or-wasteland ambiguity turns the outcome into a perilous spatial passage.

changed_reading.before: A place of success awaits the protected.
changed_reading.after: The protected have a successful passage through terrain whose danger is inseparable from the meaning of deliverance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ف و ز inventory for مَفَازًا preserves a branch of death, perishing, or passing away alongside rescue.
baseline_models.mechanism: The outcome can provisionally be read as a protected completion of worldly life rather than indefinite bodily survival; the focus alone does not settle how that terminal sense relates to the beneficial sense.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate self-protection keeps the terminal reading tied to the recipients' posture.
Passing from the world by death supplies a terminal rather than merely triumphant edge.

changed_reading.after: Their favorable outcome may include a protected passage out of worldly life, although the focus does not settle that branch.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first presents fixed supports, then removes the mountains and turns their apparent solidity into mirage. This weakens a literal-terrestrial shelter model: the protection and outcome of 78:31 must remain effective when familiar physical barriers no longer do.

activation_trace.role: A harm-blocking barrier is the focus image whose material realization is tested.
The military shelter branch supplies the literal locale that context destabilizes.
Stake-like upright fixity initially makes created shelter appear structurally dependable.
Removal and displacement reverse the earlier image of fixed support.
A water-like mirage converts apparent mass and security into deceptive appearance.

structural_cues: The bedded earth and staked mountains of 78:6-7 are reversed by the opened sky and displaced, mirage-like mountains of 78:19-20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies initial fixity and later displacement into mirage; I infer that this reversal demotes a literal physical shelter as the main referent of مَفَازًا. A live alternative is that the upheaval only dates the reward and does not qualify its spatiality.

changed_reading.before: The protected receive a stable physical stronghold.
changed_reading.after: Their protection cannot depend primarily on the world's present physical anchors; any shelter image must be secondary or transformed.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier garden can carry the image of a protective shield, and the first item after the focus is a garden defined by enclosure. These cues spatialize و ق ي and give ف و ز an inhabitable content: rescue is entry into a bounded, fertile ecology rather than bare removal from pain.

activation_trace.role: Interposed protection supplies the focus-side logic of enclosure.
Rescue joined to obtaining good makes the enclosure a positive habitat.
The garden root's shield image links cultivated cover directly to protection.
The enclosed-garden image supplies the immediate material form of the safe outcome.

structural_cues: The water-to-growth sequence of 78:14-16 ends in interlaced gardens, while 78:31 is immediately unfolded by gardens and grapes in 78:32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shield and enclosure branches plus the two garden placements; I infer that the later garden realizes the focus pair as protected fertility. The alternative is that gardens are adjacent rewards without semantically specifying و ق ي or ف و ز.

changed_reading.before: The outcome is generic escape and gain.
changed_reading.after: The outcome is an enclosed, fertile habitat in which protection is spatial and gain is continuously livable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dormant deadly-waste pole of مَفَازًا is activated by a water-like mirage and the condemned group's lack of coolness and drink, then reversed after the focus by a cup filled to its limit. The protected outcome reads as successful transit from deceptive or hostile water conditions into complete provision.

activation_trace.role: Protection against injury marks why the same perilous terrain has a different outcome for this group.
The rescue-or-waterless-waste image supplies the governing desert ambiguity.
Shimmering apparent water supplies the deceptive desert horizon.
Coolness opposed to heat supplies the relief explicitly withheld from the condemned.
Taking liquid supplies the basic survival resource that the negative clause denies.
Scalding water turns the apparent answer to thirst into an added hazard.
A cup filled to its top supplies the post-focus reversal from deprivation to plenitude.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from mirage in 78:20, through denied and harmful drink in 78:24-25, across the focus in 78:31, to the full cup in 78:34.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the wasteland branch and a staged water contrast; I infer a crossing from counterfeit or hostile provision to complete provision. The alternative is a juxtaposition of punishments and rewards without a continuous journey mechanism.

changed_reading.before: مَفَازًا is a static destination called success.
changed_reading.after: مَفَازًا is the protected completion of a lethal desert-like passage, ending where false water and thirst are replaced by a completely filled cup.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hell is presented as a watch-site on a road and as the transgressors' return-place, while the same return root later marks a return one may take toward the Lord. مَفَازًا can therefore occupy the alternate route: successful arrival through an exposed, monitored bifurcation.

activation_trace.role: The perilous passage branch lets the focus participate in the surah's route topology.
A watch-position located on a road supplies danger at the route rather than only at its endpoint.
Return to a homeward place identifies the transgressors' adverse destination.
The repeated return-place image supplies a contrasting destination directed toward the Lord.

structural_cues: 78:21-23 assigns a watched return-place to transgressors, whereas 78:39 offers a return-place toward the Lord after the protected outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a road-watch and two opposed uses of return-place; I infer a bifurcating route whose successful branch is مَفَازًا. The alternative is that the terms merely label independent destinations without depicting transit.

changed_reading.before: The protected simply possess a reward destination.
changed_reading.after: Their مَفَازًا is successful arrival on the counter-route to the watched return-place assigned to transgression.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recompense appears on both sides of the focus: the first is fitted to its cause, while the second is giving characterized by counting or sufficiency. The winning-and-obtaining sense of ف و ز is therefore not lucky escape but a deliberately conferred settlement adequate to its recipient.

activation_trace.role: Winning good and taking possession supplies the focus-side language of receipt.
A response matched to an action makes the outcome an adjudicated recompense.
A measure equal to need or counterpart supplies the matching principle on the punishment side.
Sufficiency and enrichment make the favorable recompense adequate rather than merely minimal.
Handing something over supplies the transfer by which the protected possess their outcome.

structural_cues: جَزَاءً occurs in 78:26 and again in 78:36, bracketing the focus with adverse correspondence and favorable gift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched recompense, sufficiency, and giving; I infer that this system specifies how the ف و ز outcome is caused and transferred. A live alternative is that حِسَابًا marks abundance rather than measured accounting, while still supporting adequacy.

changed_reading.before: The protected happen to escape and win.
changed_reading.after: Their escape-and-gain is an intentionally bestowed, sufficient recompense within the surah's two-sided system of correspondence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised condition removes not just bodily danger but reception of futile noise and falsehood. The protective force of و ق ي thus extends into an auditory and social ecology in which corrosive communication does not reach the recipients.

activation_trace.role: A barrier against injury supplies the focus anchor for nonphysical protection.
Speech contrary to truth supplies one harmful content excluded from the environment.
Auditory reception locates the protection at what reaches the inhabitants.
Mixed, clamorous noise supplies the social disturbance removed from the outcome.

structural_cues: After the material gifts of 78:32-34, 78:35 defines the environment negatively by what its inhabitants do not hear; falsehood also recalls the denial in 78:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies excluded hearing, noise, and falsehood; I infer that their absence is a realized form of و ق ي protection. The alternative is that the line characterizes residents' conduct rather than a barrier around them.

changed_reading.before: Protection concerns bodily rescue and material provision.
changed_reading.after: The safe outcome also shields attention and social life from futile noise and falsehood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence turns the label مُتَّقِينَ into a process: one wills, takes a return toward the Lord, is warned into caution, and finally encounters what one's hands sent ahead. Protection is prospective action undertaken before exposure, not passive membership in a favored class.

activation_trace.role: Placing oneself in protection supplies the focus-side reflexive action.
A chosen homeward return supplies the direction of preventive movement.
Will attached to an object supplies agency rather than automatic allocation.
Adopting or acquiring something makes the return a course deliberately taken.
A warning that awakens caution supplies the anticipatory stimulus for protection.
Advancing something ahead supplies the temporal priority of action over reckoning.
What the hands earn makes prior agency inspectable at the final encounter.

structural_cues: After naming the protected and their outcome, 78:39-40 shifts to whoever wills, takes a return, receives warning, and sees prior action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies choice, taking, warning-induced caution, and deeds sent ahead; I infer that these unpack the active posture in مُتَّقِينَ. The alternative is that the closing exhortation addresses everyone without defining the earlier group.

changed_reading.before: The protected are a fixed category that passively receives success.
changed_reading.after: The protected are those who prospectively take a homeward course and build protection through action before the near encounter exposes what was sent ahead.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping of ز ي د into a provision-for-travel branch even though the surface clause speaks of increasing punishment. It remains anchored by the waterless-passage branch of مَفَازًا and by immediate adjacency at 78:30-31. Downstream prose should present it only as a possible counter-image of a provisioned crossing, not as the lexical meaning of نَّزِيدَكُمْ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ف و ز branch makes مَفَازًا a potentially waterless, deadly passage, while و ق ي marks its successful traversers as protected.

activation_trace.role: Protection from injury distinguishes a supplied crossing from lethal exposure.
The waterless-waste branch supplies the journey that would require provisions.
The non-dominant image of carrying provisions for a transition supplies the adjacent journey counter-image.
A water container sharpens the contrast between punishment's increase and safe passage through a waterless expanse.

changed_reading.before: 78:30 increases punishment and 78:31 independently announces success.
changed_reading.after: The adjacency may faintly contrast an ever-growing burden with a protected, provisioned crossing through the deadly waste latent in مَفَازًا.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is odd because the army-pavilion branch of ف و ز is remote from the usual abstract sense of success. It remains directly anchored in مَفَازًا, and the later angelic rank supplies an ordered-host context. Downstream prose should call it a faint pavilion or protected-station image, never identify the reward literally with a military tent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَفَازًا has a branch naming an erected structure or canopy among an army, and مُتَّقِينَ supplies its guarded occupants.

activation_trace.role: Interposed protection gives the pavilion a defensive function.
The army shelter image supplies the unusual concrete reading of the focus noun.
The angel branch identifies the nonhuman company present at the final assembly.
Alignment on a level row supplies the ordered-host image that reactivates the pavilion branch.

changed_reading.before: The safe outcome is wholly abstract.
changed_reading.after: A faint secondary image presents it as a protected station within the ordered final assembly.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ء ي د mapping under the packet's ي د ي cue, and the actual hand clause describes the unbeliever's retrospective sight. It remains anchored to the harm-blocking و ق ي image and to actions advanced by the hands. Downstream prose should frame it as a counterfactual possibility that prior deeds can become protective support, not as a direct gloss of يَدَاهُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The و ق ي term in مُتَّقِينَ makes protection the defining posture to which an advance-built support can attach.

activation_trace.role: A barrier against harm supplies the kind of support that prior action might construct.
Advancing ahead supplies the temporal mechanism by which protection could precede the encounter.
The non-dominant protective-strength image turns the hands' prior output into a possible supporting shield.

changed_reading.before: Taqwā is only an inward caution recognized at the end.
changed_reading.after: Taqwā may also be imagined as protection built in advance by action, whose supporting or failing form becomes visible when each person sees what the hands sent ahead.

strongest_changes: The rescue-or-wasteland ambiguity of مَفَازًا became a desert-crossing mechanism through mirage, denied or hostile drink, and the later full cup.
Garden shielding and enclosure turned generic rescue into an inhabitable ecology of protected fertility.
Recompense, correspondence, sufficiency, and giving recast the outcome as a deliberately bestowed settlement rather than lucky escape.
The closing choice, warning, and prior deeds revised مُتَّقِينَ from a passive category into an anticipatory protective practice.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package simultaneously destabilized literal material shelter and activated route, enclosure, water, accounting, speech, and agency mechanisms; its split mappings also preserved provision-for-travel and protective-hand outliers that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The continuous desert route may be a strong branch resonance rather than the intended spatial organization of the punishment and reward sequences.
حِسَابًا can weight measured accounting, sufficiency, or abundance differently without dissolving the bestowal model.
The mortality and military-pavilion senses of ف و ز remain directly anchored but require explicit qualification.
The two non-dominant split-root outliers depend on how much interpretive weight such mapped branches should receive.
